title: Fix CI test coverage threshold failures
body:
CI Test job failing due to coverage below thresholds: lines 62.47%/64%, functions 53.21%/54%, statements 60.76%/62%. Build, lint, docs, and E2E jobs all green.

Added tests for three previously uncovered packages:

### Permissions (`packages/permissions/src/__tests__/`)
- `evaluator.test.ts` — `evaluatePermission` (RBAC, role inheritance, row-level) and `evaluateCondition` (all 11 operators, prototype pollution guard)
- `store.test.ts` — `createPermissionStore` with dynamic role/permission mutation
- `PermissionProvider.test.tsx` — context integration: `usePermissions`, `useFieldPermissions`, field defaults, row filters, no-provider fallback
- `PermissionGuard.test.tsx` — hide/disable/custom fallback modes

### Mobile (`packages/mobile/src/__tests__/`)
- `useBreakpoint.test.ts`, `useResponsive.test.ts`, `useResponsiveConfig.test.ts`, `useTouchTarget.test.ts`
- `pwa.test.ts` — `generatePWAManifest` with defaults and icon mapping
- `serviceWorker.test.ts` — registration, error handling, missing navigator
- `ResponsiveContainer.test.tsx` — `showOn`/`hideOn`/`minBreakpoint` conditional rendering

### Auth (`packages/auth/src/__tests__/`)
- `LoginForm.test.tsx`, `RegisterForm.test.tsx`, `ForgotPasswordForm.test.tsx` — rendering, submission, validation errors, auth context integration via `AuthCtx.Provider`
- `UserMenu.test.tsx` — avatar/initials rendering, profile/settings/signOut actions

All 238 test files pass (4222 tests), all four coverage thresholds now met.
